filter.purpose: Find public traces connected to a concept, entity, origin layer and event type.

expected_output.summary: A list of public or redacted traces showing where the concept appeared, how it moved and which entities or layers touched it.

notes.english: This is a fictional, sanitized example. It shows how discourse archaeology can search by origin, layer, entity, concept and event relation instead of only searching for words.
notes.deutsch: Dies ist ein fiktives, bereinigtes Beispiel. Es zeigt, wie Diskursarchäologie nach Herkunft, Schicht, Entität, Konzept und Ereignisbeziehung suchen kann, statt nur nach Wörtern zu suchen.
